profile.title: Senior Freelance Frontend Engineer
profile.summary: Senior freelance frontend developer with 10+ years of experience building large-scale web applications and digital platforms for enterprise, public-sector, and agency clients. Specialised in React, Next.js, Vue, TypeScript, frontend architecture, accessibility, and performance optimisation.

freelance.availability: Available for freelance projects and long-term collaborations

projectSupplements.details: Freelance engagement via Scholz & Volkmer GmbH for Deutsche Bahn (March 2024 – February 2026). Software used by service staff to inform travelers about train connections, delays, and related updates. Christian implemented Vue-based components, performed bug-fixing, and integrated APIs. Also built with TypeScript across desktop, mobile, customer displays, and dedicated hardware terminals.

Freelance engagement via Scholz & Volkmer GmbH (June 2025 – September 2025). German Federal Ministry of Education and Research (BMBF) initiative focused on environment and sustainability. Developed a Vue/Nuxt web app combined with physical sensors as a toolkit for citizens without formal academic training. Christian led initial frontend setup and visualised sensor data from a Directus backend on maps using MapTiler and Leaflet.
React, TypeScript, and TanStack Query management platform for monitoring production equipment and scheduling maintenance in a large-scale dairy manufacturing environment.
Built scalable React frontend components and AEM templates for BMW's corporate platform.
Led frontend architecture on Liferay, delivering reusable portal components in close collaboration with design and backend teams.
Frontend lead for the mobile web launch experience. Led the swipeable mobile version of an HTML scrollpage with fullscreen imagery and device-independent usage.
Contributed to the official McDonald's Germany iOS application. The app reached more than 2 million downloads and ranked among the top 15 most downloaded iPhone apps in Germany in 2012.
Led frontend development for national campaigns including Do-Your-Own-Coupons, Mexify Yourself, Blend-in-Cup, and Big Mac Hunt.

webShop.title: Ecommerce Platform
webShop.summary: A production-ready ecommerce platform built with Payload CMS, Next.js, TypeScript, and Stripe. It includes everything needed to launch a branded online store: product management, payments, multilingual support, SEO tools, and a modern administration interface. Available as either a managed SaaS subscription or a one-time licence purchase, enabling businesses to get online faster without starting from scratch.

features.title: Your brand, your store
features.description: Use your own domain, logo, colours, and styling to create a storefront that matches your business.

features.title: Product management
features.description: Manage products, variants, categories, pricing, and media through an intuitive admin interface with draft previews before publishing.

features.title: Shopping experience
features.description: Carts, favourites, guest checkout, order history, and secure order lookup.

features.title: Secure payments
features.description: Accept online payments with a seamless checkout experience and automated order confirmations.

features.title: Content and SEO
features.description: Create landing pages, manage content, control SEO settings, and schedule updates when needed.

features.title: Shipping and international sales
features.description: Configure shipping rules and support multiple languages for customers across different markets.

technology: Payload CMS for products and content
Next.js for the storefront and admin experience
Vitest and Playwright for automated testing
